mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_course_reviews r JOIN tb_courses c ON c.id = r.course_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, AVG(rating) AS average_rating, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 5) AS count5, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 4) AS count4, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 3) AS count3, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 2) AS count2, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 1) AS count1 FROM tb_course_reviews WHERE course_id = #{courseId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_completions cp JOIN tb_enrollments e ON e.id = cp.enrollment_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND cp.status = 'COMPLETED' AND cp.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_course_reviews r WHERE r.user_id = e.user_id AND r.course_id = e.course_id)
